principles.title: Specialized
principles.text: Each AI Employee has a defined job, not a generic prompt.

principles.title: Connected
principles.text: They can work with CRM, ERP, email, calendars, ecommerce and documents.

principles.title: Governed
principles.text: Permissions, policies and human approvals define what they can do.

principles.title: Private

definition.title: More than a chatbot: a digital work unit with a role, tools and boundaries.
definition.body: An AI Employee represents a concrete business role. It receives work, checks authorized information, uses approved tools, delivers results and asks for human intervention when a decision exceeds its authority.

workflow.title: One problem can move across several employees without losing the process context.
workflow.description: Educational example: a customer detects an invoice error and asks to cancel an order. Work moves through the right profiles and pauses for approval when policy requires it.

steps.title: Support receives
steps.text: Understands the request and checks customer and order context.

steps.title: Accounting validates
steps.text: Checks the invoice and identifies the discrepancy.

steps.title: Administration corrects
steps.text: Prepares or updates the permitted record.

steps.title: Human approves
steps.text: Cancellation pauses when authorization is required.

steps.title: Support resolves
steps.text: Communicates the result and closes the case.

workflow.disclaimer: Illustrative scenario using synthetic data. Real authority depends on the configuration, integrations and policies of each deployment.

systems.title: AI Employees should connect to real work, not live in an isolated chat window.
systems.description: IA Empleado separates the job, capabilities and integrations. Each company enables only what is necessary for its approved processes.

security.title: Autonomy does not mean unlimited authority.
security.description: IA Empleado is designed around explicit permissions, deterministic policies, human approvals and private deployments. A technical capability never grants business authority by itself.

items.title: Explicit boundaries
items.text: Each role receives only the approved capabilities and tools.

items.title: Human approval
items.text: Sensitive actions can pause before they are executed.

items.title: Private deployment
items.text: Customer production can run in private or dedicated infrastructure.

faq.title: Understand IA Empleado without ambiguous language.

items.question: What is an AI Employee?
items.answer: It is a digital worker configured for a defined business role with objectives, tools, permissions, policies and supervision. It is not simply a chatbot with a job title.

items.question: Can AI Employees work with each other?
items.answer: The product vision includes teams of specialized profiles coordinating tasks and structured context. The concrete availability of each workflow depends on implemented and validated capabilities and integrations.

items.question: Can it connect to my company systems?
items.answer: The platform is designed to integrate systems such as CRM, ERP, email, calendar, ecommerce, ticketing, documents and APIs through scoped connectors and permissions.

items.question: Does AI make every decision automatically?
items.answer: No. Important actions can require deterministic rules and human approval. Autonomy is configured and never means authority without limits.

items.question: Can it be installed privately?
items.answer: The architecture is designed to allow production in customer-controlled infrastructure or a dedicated private environment, depending on deployment scope.

cta.title: Design the AI team that makes sense for your company.
cta.description: Identify the process, systems involved, permitted actions and where a person must intervene. From there, define the team and capabilities required.

footer.tagline: Specialized AI Employees working with people, systems and real business processes.
